entities.name: Twilio
entities.how_described: 本集主讲人 Kanesh Manuja 的任职公司——他是 Twilio 的首席工程师，分享团队在生产环境运营 LLM 网关的实战教训。

evidence.quote: I'm a principal engineer at Twilio.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: LLM 网关 (LLM gateway)
entities.how_described: 本集主题：架在应用与模型供应商之间的入口点/中间件，负责路由、认证、回退、速率限制和治理；其核心是可用性、延迟、护栏、成本四者的取舍。

evidence.quote: So what is an LLM gateway?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: An LLM gateway is an entry point or a middleware between your apps and the model providers behind them.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: If you use an LLM gateway, I want to help you to make that trade-off for your use case.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We haven't discussed that we are actually adding another dependency in the request path itself, which is the central or which is the LLM gateway itself.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: There are a few things where we have been bitten by and we've learned some lessons that I want to share with you if you're working on an LLM gateway or using one.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 回退 (fallback)
entities.how_described: 本集主张对 LLM 用按请求回退替代盲目重试：先试供应商 A 失败再试 B；回退不透明、流式输出锁死选择、备用供应商容量反而要更高是反复踩的坑。

evidence.quote: It does a bunch of things, routing, authentication, fallback, rate limits, all kinds of governance that you can think of.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It is actually a per-request fallback.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: But the second provider, the fallback provider, doesn't necessarily get the same level of love.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And I would argue that your throughputs or your capacity or your headroom should be even higher for the second provider or the fallback provider because that's your last line of defense.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Another important thing is fallback.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 断路器 (circuit breaker)
entities.how_described: 本集说传统断路器（失败够多就跳闸停止调用）对 LLM 不够用，但可借用其模式：主供应商持续失败就移出请求路径、放进冷却期。

evidence.quote: And when all of that fails, you have a circuit breaker that trips after you've seen sufficient failures, and you stop calling the damn thing.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And also, tripping over a circuit breaker when you have another perfectly fine model provider to route to doesn't make sense.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 延迟 (latency)
entities.how_described: 本集称高延迟是悄无声息的杀手：别测网关级聚合延迟（『是个谎言』），要按模型按路由追踪 P99，并按路由设超时——没有超时是静默故障的头号根因。

evidence.quote: It's availability, latency, your guardrails, and costs.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Retrying an LLM API eats into your latency budget really fast.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Quick show of hands if you measure your aggregate latency for your entire service.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So you definitely need to track latency per route.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So this is where truly the latency is unpredictable.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You can fire another request if your primary request actually consumed, let's say, P90 of your latency budget.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You can have a prehook where the guardrail actually runs on the input, and that's probably the safest, but it does add serial latency to your requests.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 护栏 (guardrails)
entities.how_described: 本集说护栏负责防提示词注入、PII 过滤、毒性过滤，但它像另一个会宕机的服务，必须选 fail open 还是 fail close，并给它时间预算和二级回退。

evidence.quote: It's availability, latency, your guardrails, and costs.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: To keep your model secure, you need to have guardrails.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And with that, guardrails are necessary for preventing your services from prompt injection attacks, keeping PII filters in place, having toxicity filters, keeping the LLMs to stop swearing at your customers.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Guardrails are just like another service.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: When I say fail open, you can still serve the request even if your guardrails are down.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: There are a few things that you can actually do to improve the behavior of your systems in face of guardrails being down and managing just unreliability of the guardrails themselves.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So make sure that you have timeouts in place, and those guardrails run with a specific time budget.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You've heard, you probably know, and I've talked about it, we always discuss fallbacks with regards to model providers, but guardrails are critical services too, where you can consider fallbacks, have secondary providers, secondary checks, cash decisions to keep your service available when
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Another interesting choice that pops up with regards to guardrails is the placement of the guardrails.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Try to save your latencies and run these guardrails concurrently for your structured outputs.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 提示词注入 (prompt injection)
entities.how_described: 本集把防提示词注入攻击列为部署护栏的必要理由之一。

evidence.quote: And with that, guardrails are necessary for preventing your services from prompt injection attacks, keeping PII filters in place, having toxicity filters, keeping the LLMs to stop swearing at your customers.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 推理模型 (reasoning models)
entities.how_described: 本集说推理模型高度非确定，同一提示词耗时可能 2 秒到 60 秒不等——『推理模型的正常相当于聊天模型的故障』，建议按路由固定推理级别。

evidence.quote: Reasoning models normal is actually a chat models outage.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And reasoning models, they do not give you
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: fail open
entities.how_described: 本集说护栏宕机时要选 fail open（仍放行请求）还是 fail close（拦截请求），本质是可用性与安全的权衡，默认应选你所能忍受的最坏情况。

evidence.quote: Do you fail open or do you fail close?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: When I say fail open, you can still serve the request even if your guardrails are down.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 负载卸载 (load shedding)
entities.how_described: 本集强调网关必须支持负载卸载并纳入操作手册和演练日：重试风暴下没法简单横向扩容，web 服务器内部队列必须有界。

evidence.quote: Another thing is load shedding.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: This is a feature that you should, as part of your run books, game days, make sure that the gateway that you're using supports load shedding.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 对冲长尾 (hedging the tail)
entities.how_described: 本集提出当主请求消耗到延迟预算的 P90 时再发起另一个请求，以压住 P99 长尾。

evidence.quote: Another idea is hedging the tail.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 集中式治理 (centralized governance)
entities.how_described: 本集结论：大多数公司想要的不是中央网关而是集中式治理——把网关去中心化、流量别集中，用插件和自定义代码集中成本追踪与速率限制管理。

evidence.quote: They want centralized governance.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
